content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electricity generation and telecom services to remote Alaska communities, not water or wastewater utility service."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility selling metered water and sewer service to homes and businesses from owned wells and networks."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Commercial landscape maintenance and installation contracting, a labor-based service business with no utility operations."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Regulated natural gas and electric distribution plus propane sales, a different energy utility business from water service."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric, gas and steam delivery utility in New York, not water or wastewater service."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gathering and processing of Permian hydrocarbons for producers, an oil and gas business rather than water utility service."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility serving residential and commercial customers from owned treatment plants and networks under state tariffs."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Florida land development, residential lot sales, hotels and resorts, a real estate and hospitality business rather than utility operations."}]}
